priority.override_reason: Ranks one and two are closed for this cycle by the current direct-leaf frame, compact-dispatch, scalar-recursion, contiguous-frame-stack, object-arena, property-layout, and Value-lifetime rejection evidence. Rank-three A* still spends nearly half of its exact current profile in the generic interpreter and repeatedly executes the distinct array[index].numberField chain. The previous typed-loop object-field unit materialized array elements and field results in boxed Value registers and regressed A* by 15.5%; this unit instead fuses the producer and numeric consumer so neither intermediate Value exists. It does not retune that unit's boxed-operation threshold, property-cache ordering, or guard placement.

mechanism.summary: When an admitted typed-loop region contains a computed read from a read-only dense local Array immediately followed by a named property read, lower both bytecode operations to one guarded scalar operation. It borrows the present array element, requires an ordinary Object with a live own Number data slot, and writes the Number directly to the scalar register file without cloning the element or field Value; every miss deoptimizes at the original computed read before observable work.
mechanism.generality: Admission depends only on typed-loop bytecode dataflow and live runtime tags: a read-only frame slot must hold an Array, the index must be a present dense integer element, the element must be an ordinary Object, and the named property must be a current own Number data property addressable through compact shared-slot storage. It never inspects source paths, benchmark names, function or property spellings, input sizes, iteration counts, checksums, or results. Holes, special indexed descriptors, accessor or inherited fields, Proxies, primitives, non-Number fields, mutated layouts, dynamic scope, direct eval, and unsupported control flow deopt before the original GetProp can observe anything.
semantic_risks: preserving computed property-key coercion and prototype lookup by declining before observable work whenever the index is not a present dense integer element
holding only a scoped borrow of the array element while reading the ordinary object field, without leaking a reference across array or object mutation
revalidating the interned field key and compact slot on every object so deletion, redefinition, layout change, accessors, and non-Number replacement cannot expose stale data
anchoring deoptimization at the original computed GetProp with the exact pre-operation scalar and boxed stack state
leaving the rejected generic boxed object-field scalarization, boxed-operation profitability threshold, and all non-fused typed-loop operations unchanged
